attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-66384 - JFrog Artifactory Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability. This can allow an authenticated user to write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2021-23758 - Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2015-3246 - Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2015-5287 - Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool (ABRT) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow local users with certain permissions to gain privileges via a symlink attack on a file with a predictable name. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to…

attack_surface.title: CVE-2022-0995 - Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability which could allow a local user to gain privileged access or cause a denial of service on the system.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-8452 - Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2019-1068 - Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-60004 - Gitea Code Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-21962 - Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in Improper Access Control Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in contain an improper access control vulnerability that can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server…
attack_surface.product: HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-73570 - Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-72530 - TrueConf Server Code Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-72529 - TrueConf Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: TrueConf Server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthorized attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to execute an arbitrary script.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-64849 - MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-33824 - Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-59310 - Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-55040 - Microsoft SharePoint Weak Authentication Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a weak authentication vulnerability which allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-65400 - Apple macOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2025-62593 - Ray-Project Ray Code Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-20349 - Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Heap Inspection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) contain a heap inspection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.
attack_surface.product: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD)

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-68820 - Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
attack_surface.product: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock

From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the…

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-8037 - Progress LoadMaster Command Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-63077 - JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-18556 - N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-34486 - Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2025‑24813.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-9198 - IBM Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve full remote code execution on default Langflow deployments.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-18577 - N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel allows for authentication bypass and account takeover in N-central. This vulnerability is the result of an incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556.
